description:
Survival Mode - Lite

In between vanilla and survival mode - Fully customizable!

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
Keeps everything the 0.98.5a Survival mode does, with every penalty halfway to vanilla. With LunaLib you set each number yourself.

In Between Vanilla and Survival
Start a new game and pick Survival, as usual.
Every survival number starts at Lite: halfway between vanilla and survival.
Ships cost x3 to x4.5 instead of x5 to x8, weapons x5.5 instead of x10, crew x5.5 instead of x10.
Markets sell more, enemies drop more, fuel tanks hold more, colonies grow faster, 3 story points per level instead of 2.
What survival makes easier stays: threats grow 3 times slower, more Domain-grade parts for sale, bigger custom production orders.
Normal campaigns are not touched.

Fully Customizable (LunaLib, optional)
136 settings, one for every survival number, in 12 tabs: Prices, Pay, Markets, Loot, Fuel, Colonies, Officers, Experience, Hazards, Retirement, Survival help and Rules.
Each setting shows its survival and its vanilla value, so you can pick anything in between, or past either end.
Want survival prices but vanilla loot? Vanilla fuel but survival colonies? Set it.
The survival rules that are settings can be switched off too, like the military market needing a commission.
Changes apply at once, in a game in progress. A few apply only when a new sector is made, and their description says so.
Without LunaLib the Lite values apply.

aiDescription: Modifies the standard Survival mode so that all penalties are reduced to half their original severity. It adjusts ship prices, loot drops, fuel consumption, colony growth, and other factors to sit midway between vanilla and Survival settings. If LunaLib is installed, players can customize every individual survival setting through a detailed configuration menu.
